test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Given below is a statement followed by two possible conclusions I and II. Read the information carefully and select the correct option.

**Statement:**

Five of the biggest MNCs in country X have announced their hiring plan of the next eight years under which they plan to hire three times the number of MBA graduates than the usual number of MBA graduates hired every year.

Which of the following can be concluded from the given information?

I: All colleges offering MBA courses will double their fees from the next academic year.

II. The number of applicants in MBA courses in country X will increase to some extent in the coming few years.

options.text: Only II can be concluded from the given information.
Neither I nor II can be concluded from the given information.
Both I and II can be concluded from the given information.
Only I can be concluded from the given information.
